mainText: Hello, Verona! At 4 PM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 61 degrees with overcast skies near the Verona Public Library and an air quality index of 55.

The city recently reached a major milestone with the unanimous adoption of the Envision Verona Comprehensive Plan, a long-range vision for local growth, housing, and infrastructure that was shaped by extensive community feedback.
There is plenty to do this week, including live music at Bailey's Run today, and a wonderful community celebration called Puppets in the Park happening tomorrow at Century School Park.
In a noteworthy update, on October 3, the Verona Police Department assisted another agency in locating a stolen firearm, leading to the arrest of a 19-year-old local man.
Today's featured flavor at Culver's is OREO Cookie Overload, and you can stop by any time before they close at 10:30 PM.
